command: /feature-flow-lite:feature-flow-lite Build a website for Marginalia Books, a fictional independent bookshop. At least four pages linked by a shared nav: home, books (a catalog of at least 8 titles you can filter by genre), events, and visit (hours, address, and a contact form). Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no build step and no external network requests (no CDNs, no web fonts). JavaScript is required, so it doesn't need to work with JavaScript turned off. It must be responsive down to 360px wide and be accessible. Put index.html at the repo root.
